_metadata.description: Reachability-derived warm/cold version placement with durable, hash-verified recovery.

requirements.title: Evicted identity survives reindex
requirements.description: An evicted version remains represented by its manifest declaration and component version/file rows after repeated indexing.

requirements.title: Evicted imports remain in the reachability graph
requirements.description: Source imports from an evicted version are read from the durable file mirror and continue protecting their referenced versions.

requirements.title: Materialization is reversible and hash verified
requirements.description: Materializing an evicted version restores the complete file set byte-for-byte, is idempotent and concurrency-safe, and refuses a mismatched mirror.

requirements.title: Presence reconciliation is idempotent
requirements.description: Reconciliation uses the reachability graph, applies only required moves, and leaves a second run with no pending changes.

requirements.title: Adoption materializes before recording
requirements.description: Linking an evicted version restores it before writing the adoption, and materialization failure leaves no adoption record.

requirements.title: The ledger is portable
requirements.description: The identity and file mirror can be exported to a checksum-verified archive and imported into an empty database.

requirements.title: Report payload storage is byte bounded
requirements.description: Component-test report retention enforces the declared aggregate payload ceiling while preserving rollup counters.

requirements.title: Raw story text nodes are rejected
requirements.description: Story contracts use plain text values and the grammar rejects legacy raw $text nodes.
